article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New? (Aperçu des métiers et des Mises à Jour du Contenu)
article_summaries.summary: A French-language official news post (captured 2011) announcing the 'Job Preview' system, which lets free accounts try member-only jobs up to level 5, effective for characters created after 1 November 2009. It also lists upcoming content: housing with decorations, a simplified pet trainer trophy system with new pets, fishing, daily events, a lighter UI and clothing dye. The post is dated only relatively ('1 year, 7 months ago'), so its exact date is unknown.
